fact: Datasanté reports that DataBox servers and tablets were distributed to community doctors in November 2019, that a study of the 35 doctors trained and equipped (25 private, 10 public) found 10 using the patient record software regularly and 20 irregularly, with 12 having created more than 1,000 patient files, and that one rural doctor keeps no paper register, every consultation being in each patient's computerised file.
title: MADAGASCAR : Nos réalisations
